answers.answer: Shuffle all four III cards and place them at the bottom; shuffle nine II and deal five above them; shuffle three I and deal one on top, making a 10-card deck. Return unused I and II cards unseen to the box.

Four players: Score marker starts at 1; three Agents total (two on Leader, third Swordmaster beside board); 12 troops total, with three in garrison and nine in supply; take 1 water. Three players: score starts at 0; Agents, troop setup and water are the same.

Yes, you may Reveal while Agents remain; after Revealing, your turns are skipped for the rest of Player Turns, so no later Agent turn that round. Reveal effects come only from cards revealed from your remaining hand, not Agent-played cards. At Clean Up, all cards in front of you from Agent and Reveal turns go to your discard pile.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: Player Turns; Reveal Turn

answers.answer: No. Resources needed for entry must be held immediately before placement and before space or played Agent-card effects resolve; a Plot Intrigue played before placement may supply them. One card sends only one Agent. A card with no Agent icons cannot be used for an Agent turn.

At a Combat space, deploy all three troops recruited this turn plus up to two of the four already in your garrison, for at most five. At a non-Combat space, no normal deployment is allowed. Recruited troops come from your supply and are placed in your garrison before deployment.
answers.evidence: Actions: Recruiting & Deploying Units; FAQ: Combat and troops

answers.answer: The Spy Agent icon permits sending an Agent to a space connected to a post where you have a Spy, without recalling that Spy. Infiltrate recalls a Spy from a connected post to bypass another player's Agent at the destination. Gather Intelligence recalls a Spy from a connected post to draw a card; choose it immediately after Agent placement, before space/card effects. One Spy cannot pay for both on the same placement; two different Spies may pay for Infiltrate and Gather Intelligence.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: Spies & observation posts; FAQ: Spies

answers.answer: Strength is 11: two troops = 4, one sandworm = 3, four swords = 4. If your last unit is removed, strength becomes 0. No unit in the Conflict means you cannot play Combat Intrigue (eligibility requires at least one deployed unit).

Yes. A pass does not bar you from playing later; the window closes after all involved players pass consecutively. After rewards, troops return to supply (not garrison), sandworms to the bank, and Combat markers reset to 0.

With four players and exactly two tied for first, both get the second reward; the remaining players compete for the third reward, but nobody wins or takes the Conflict card. With three players, first-place tie players get second reward and there are no other rewards; nobody takes the card. A zero-strength player receives no reward.

One or more sandworms doubles rewards once; two worms do not quadruple them. Control and battle icons on won Conflict cards cannot be doubled. For a reward offering 3 spice for 1 VP, you may pay 3 spice for one VP or pay 6 spice for two VP.

After winning and taking the Conflict card face up into your supply, check it against face-up Conflict or Objective cards there. A matching pair must be flipped face down for 1 VP. At Endgame, a wild battle icon may be matched with any one of the three icons in your supply, also for 1 VP.

At 2 Influence, gain 1 VP and lose that VP if you fall below 2; regain it if you reach 2 again. At 4, gain the printed track bonus, which is kept below 4 and earned again on returning to 4. The first to 4 also gets the Alliance and 1 VP tied to holding it. Tying the holder does not steal it; rising above transfers it. FAQ also says if the holder loses Influence after a tie, the formerly tied opponent takes it; if holder falls to 3 or below with no one at 4+, return it to board.
answers.evidence: Scoring: Faction Influence; FAQ: Alliance loss

answers.answer: During Reveal, Persuasion can be spent before, between or after Reveal effects to buy Imperium Row cards or either Reserve card. It can be pooled across sources or split, and unused Persuasion is lost. Row refills to five, so you may buy a replacement immediately if affordable. Acquired cards go face up into your discard pile.

An unoccupied Maker space gets one spice at Makers phase, accumulating with any already there; visiting gains all bonus spice. Deep Desert costs 3 water, Hagga Basin 1 water; each offers its base spice or, with Maker Hooks, a worm option. Hooks are a requirement only where specified and are retained, not spent. The Shield Wall prevents summoning at Arrakeen, Spice Refinery and Imperial Basin until removed. Worms are deployed directly into the Conflict, never a garrison.
answers.evidence: Phase 4: Makers; Actions: Sandworms; Board Space Guide

answers.answer: At Recall, if anyone has at least 10 VP or the Conflict deck is empty, Endgame triggers. Players may resolve Endgame Intrigues before the most-VP winner is determined. Rulebook tiebreakers: spice, then Solari, then water, then garrisoned troops.

Standard CHOAM starts with two public face-up contracts and 18 face-down in the bank. Add four CHOAM Imperium cards and four CHOAM Intrigue cards. Shaddam is optional. The ten contrasting-back contracts are for Rise of Ix only and stay out; standard uses 20 contracts.

With CHOAM, take an available public face-up contract into your supply and refill the offer face up from the bank if possible; if public offers are exhausted, gain 2 Solari. Without CHOAM, the icon gives 2 Solari. Harvest completes by visiting a Maker space and gaining its listed spice amount that turn in total; Immediate completes when taken; Acquire The Spice Must Flow completes when you next acquire that card.
answers.evidence: CHOAM Module: Taking contracts; Completing contracts

answers.answer: No. If you acquire a space contract after already sending an Agent there that turn, wait until a future turn; you must hold it when sending the Agent. On completion, announce it, gain its shown rewards, then flip it face down and leave it in your supply.

Use one shared scoring Rival as the third competitor. It gets the Ornithopter Objective; the other eligible Objectives are dealt randomly to humans. First Player belongs to the human whose Objective marks it and alternates only between humans; order is First Player → Rival → other human. Rival never Reveals.
answers.evidence: Required Rival Rules: Setup; Agent turns

answers.answer: For an occupied destination, ignore it and reveal again. A Place Spy card places a Spy at an empty post of the specified type if available; it does not place an Agent, then reveal another Hagal card and continue the same Agent turn. Ignore ordinary space costs/effects and apply only Hagal effects. If deck empties or Reshuffle appears, immediately reshuffle and continue.
answers.evidence: Required Rival Rules: Agent turns; Place Spy cards

answers.answer: Shuffle Objective cards after removing ones whose 1-3P/4/6P marking does not match the player count, then deal one face up to each player; its First Player marker identifies the first player. Shaddam cannot be used unless playing with CHOAM.

Bank resources and sandworms are not limited; make convenient substitutions if any run out. If your troop supply is empty, you cannot recruit until troops return to it. Gains come from the bank and payments return to the bank.

Phases: Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. Round Start reveals a Conflict from the deck, then each player draws five cards. If Endgame is not triggered at Recall, humans return Agents to Leaders; in 3–4 human play pass First Player clockwise; in two-player play return Rival Agents to supply and pass First Player to the other human.

Yes, space, Agent-box and Faction Influence effects may be done in any order. But entry requirements/costs must be met before resolving any placement effects, so that visit's Influence cannot satisfy its own entry requirement.

An optional arrow cost/effect can be used only once per turn (unless doubling a Conflict reward); paying it twice in an Agent turn is not allowed. Most card/space effects are mandatory; “may,” optional arrows and black-X trash are optional, while direct self-trash is mandatory. Intrigue conditions and costs must be met to play it.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: Arrows; FAQ: Mandatory effects and costs

answers.answer: A Spy placement icon puts a Spy from supply on an unoccupied observation post. If none are in supply, you may recall one from a post for no effect first. If placement specifies an Agent-icon type connected to that post, only a post with that connection is legal.

No, Infiltrate bypasses another player's Agent, not your own. Spy use does not replace playing a card to take an Agent turn or waive requirements/costs. You cannot recall two Spies to Gather Intelligence on one placement; two may be recalled for different effects, one Infiltrate and one Gather Intelligence.

The controller receives 1 Solari when anyone visits Arrakeen or Spice Refinery, or 1 spice at Imperial Basin; this is separate from visitor effects, even if controller is also visitor. Winning the relevant Conflict takes/replaces control. On reveal of a Conflict for a space already controlled, its controller may deploy one troop from supply directly to Conflict.

Two tied for second each get the third reward; first-place winner keeps first reward and Conflict card, with no further rewards. Tied for third get nothing. Three tied for first each get second reward; nobody wins/takes card and no other rewards, including in four-player game.

In three-player play, ordinary first and second receive rewards; third gets nothing. For a two-human game with Rival as third participant, same two/three-player reward rules apply: untied third gets nothing; third reward only for tie for second.

Plot Intrigue: during your Agent or Reveal turn; Combat: during Combat and only with at least one unit in Conflict; Endgame: at Endgame. Keep Intrigues face down, separate from deck, and discard resolved cards face up beside Intrigue deck. If deck empties, shuffle its discard into a new deck.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: Intrigue cards; FAQ: Draw timing

answers.answer: Ordinary discard is a card of your choice from your hand and cannot be an Intrigue unless specified. The trash-an-Intrigue icon instead trashes one Intrigue of your choice from your hand. Steal Intrigue makes each opponent with four or more Intrigues give one selected at random.

Trash effects can remove cards from hand, discard pile or in play. Ordinary cards return to box; Reserve cards return to their Reserve stack. Trashing is optional except when paying a cost or told to trash itself. The Spice Must Flow acquire VP remains even if it is later trashed.

Acquire-box effects resolve once when the card is acquired, not when played. When unable to draw because deck is empty, shuffle discard pile into a new deck. Unused Persuasion cannot be saved; it is lost at end of Reveal.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: Acquire box; Acquiring Cards

answers.answer: Cards played on Agent turns and revealed at Reveal remain in play face up until Clean Up (unless trashed first). Fremen Bond checks for one or more other Fremen cards in play; two Bond cards can activate one another regardless of order. They leave play at Clean Up.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: In play / Fremen Bond

answers.answer: Recall Agent returns one of your other Agents on the board, not the Agent just placed; it can be used on another Agent turn that round. Retreat sends a troop from Conflict to garrison. “Retreat any number” includes zero.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: Recall Agent; Retreat; FAQ: Combat and troops

answers.answer: A single free-choice gain-two Influence effect must go to one chosen Faction, not split. An Alliance icon requires holding that Faction's Alliance token; other minimum-Influence effects require the specified track level.

If holder loses Influence after a tie with two opponents, FAQ says the holder chooses which of the formerly tied opponents receives the Alliance. If holder falls to 3 or lower and nobody has 4+, return Alliance to board; former holder loses its VP.
answers.evidence: Scoring: Faction Influence; FAQ: Alliance loss

answers.answer: A card drawn during Reveal is immediately revealed and used this turn. Drawn after Reveal stays for next round, which then draws five additional cards. A Plot Intrigue with a later Reveal effect stays face up until then, is used, then discarded.
No, a “when you win” Intrigue cannot be played after tying for first. If received as a reward for an outright win, it can be played immediately.
If all four resource tiebreakers are tied, the player who most recently took a Reveal turn wins. Scores may exceed the printed track's 12.

No. Fulfill all contracts held for that same space with one Agent placement; you must hold them at the time you send the Agent. Contract effects are another Agent-turn effect and may resolve in any order with space and Agent-box effects.

Shaddam does not start with the two reserved Sardaukar contracts; only he may acquire them, choosing one instead of a public contract when acquiring. His Signet deployment restriction begins immediately when playing Signet Ring to send an Agent and lasts for that turn only.

Feyd's token begins on the leftmost Training track space and stays on the rightmost space once it reaches it. Lady Jessica begins with Lady Jessica side face up. Reverend Mother Jessica may use her ability on the turn she flips.

Moving from 1 to 3 reaches 2; it can trigger again in a later game turn after losing and regaining Influence, but moving down through 2 does not count. Clean Up moving Spacing Guild's Favor from play to discard does not trigger its discard ability; only discarding it from hand does.

Accept Contract is Spice Trade, no cost, no Combat: always draw one card and resolve contract icon (2 Solari without CHOAM; take public contract with CHOAM if available, else 2 Solari). It is not a Faction, so no automatic Influence. Dutiful Service is Emperor, no cost, no Combat: gain 1 Emperor Influence and resolve same contract icon; the Influence is counted once, not twice.
answers.evidence: Board Space Guide; Human contract icon

answers.answer: Arrakeen: City, no cost, Combat yes; visitor recruits one troop and draws one card, controller gains 1 Solari. Fremkit: Fremen, no cost, Combat yes; gain 1 Fremen Influence and draw one card. Research Station: City, costs 2 water, Combat yes; recruit two troops and draw two cards.

Deep Desert costs 3 water; choose 4 base spice or, with Hooks, two sandworms. Hagga Basin costs 1 water; choose 2 base spice or, with Hooks, one sandworm. Both also grant all accumulated bonus spice whichever option is chosen. Hooks are retained, not spent.
answers.evidence: Board Space Guide; Sandworms; FAQ: Spies

answers.answer: Both Sietch Tabr choices require City access and 2+ Fremen Influence, with no resource cost. Choose either take Maker Hooks if lacking them, recruit one troop and gain 1 water; OR gain 1 water and optionally remove Shield Wall. The Wall-removal option gives no troop.

High Council is Landsraad, no Combat. Each visit costs 5 Solari. First visit places Councilor on an unoccupied seat and grants 2 Persuasion on every Reveal for the rest of game. Later visits grant 2 spice, draw an Intrigue and recruit three troops.

Swordmaster costs 8 Solari before anyone gains one and 6 after any player (including Rival) has one; once per player per game. Take the third Agent from beside board onto Leader; it is usable that round and thereafter. Rival acquisition also lowers human cost to 6.

Imperial Privilege is Landsraad, requires 2+ Emperor Influence and costs 3 Solari; no Combat. May discard an Intrigue to draw an Intrigue, and recall one of your other Agents and draw a card. No automatic Emperor Influence.
Shipping is Spice Trade; requires 2+ Guild Influence and costs 3 spice; no Combat. Gain 5 Solari and 1 Influence with any one Faction, not necessarily Guild.

Gather Support is Landsraad, no Combat: choose 0 or 2 Solari; recruit two troops, and if paying 2 also gain 1 water. Spice Refinery is City, Combat: choose 0 or 1 spice; gain 2 Solari or 4 Solari if paid; controller separately gains 1 Solari.

Heighliner (Spacing Guild, Combat) costs 5 spice; gain 1 Guild Influence and recruit five troops. Desert Tactics (Fremen, Combat) costs 1 water; gain 1 Fremen Influence, recruit one troop, optionally trash a card. Sardaukar (Emperor, not Combat) costs 4 spice; gain 1 Emperor Influence, draw an Intrigue, recruit four troops.

Assembly Hall is Landsraad, no cost, not Combat: draw an Intrigue; if your Agent is there, gain 1 Persuasion during Reveal. Espionage is Bene Gesserit, costs 1 spice, not Combat: gain 1 BG Influence, draw a card, place Spy. Deliver Supplies is Spacing Guild, no cost, not Combat: gain 1 Guild Influence and 1 water.

False Orders: affected opponents move Spy to an empty post not connected to your Agent's destination that turn; playable even if no enemy Spy is connected there. Litany Against Fear's red box is ignored during Reveal, or when the card gains an Agent icon and is played normally as an Agent card.
Opponents cannot acquire a card removed by Manipulate. You may acquire it by other means, but without the 1-Persuasion discount. If not acquired by the end of your next Reveal, remove it from game.

Rival starts with color, four Influence cubes at track bottoms, three troops in garrison and remaining troops in supply, two Agents in supply and Swordmaster beside board, three Spies and 1 water; score and Combat markers at 0. Shuffle House Hagal near Rival, retaining 2P Reshuffle card. Rival can trigger Endgame and win at 10+ VP.

As soon as its resource total reaches printed Swordmaster value, Rival spends exactly that amount and takes third Agent, usable this round. Count Solari, spice, Intrigue cards and water in supply (each card/unit = one); mandatory spending order Solari, spice, Intrigue, water, using each before next, keeping leftovers. Do not substitute lower-priority resources to preserve higher-priority ones.
answers.evidence: Required Rival Rules: Swordmaster resource total

answers.answer: After Swordmaster, spend each qualifying set for 1 VP: 7 Solari, 7 spice, 3 Intrigue cards, or 3 water. It cannot combine mixed types to make seven.

Rival chooses the Faction with least Influence; ties break by leftmost priority. It gets 1 VP at 2 Influence (lost below 2), and the Alliance VP while it holds the token; it does not receive the resource bonus for reaching 4. A numbered Hagal Influence icon identifies that position in the Rival card’s Faction priority list.
answers.evidence: Required Rival Rules: Resource gains; Influence

answers.answer: No. Use only the destination matching current condition (Guild Influence for Accept Contract/Shipping; Conflict tier for Deliver Supplies/Heighliner). If that selected destination is occupied, reveal another Hagal card rather than use its other destination.

Yes. At every Combat space Rival deploys up to two available garrison troops even if no troops were newly recruited. Troops recruited by Hagal at noncombat spaces go to garrison. Unmet 2+ Influence bonus is ignored and never prevents placement.

Unless post type specified, place Rival Spy at first available Faction observation post in priority order; if all four are occupied, ignore placement. Its third/final supply Spy triggers recall of the other two and its Scheme. Rival never recalls Spies to Infiltrate or Gather Intelligence.
answers.evidence: Required Rival Rules: Spies and Schemes

answers.answer: Scheme-recruited troops before placement count as newly recruited and deploy if Rival then visits Combat space that turn. A Place Spy card with no legal post is ignored; reveal another Hagal card and continue because it did not send an Agent.
answers.evidence: Required Rival Rules: Spies and Schemes

answers.answer: Rival collects all bonus spice at a visited Maker space. With Hooks at Hagga/Deep it summons one/two worms instead of base spice if Conflict allows worms; if it summons none, take base 2/4 spice instead. Without Hooks it takes base spice. Imperial Basin always gives 1 base spice. Protected Shield Wall Conflict prevents worms; accumulated bonus spice is still collected.

At Combat start, if Rival has at least one unit deployed, reveal one Hagal card in turn order and add its bottom swords to strength; on Reshuffle, reshuffle and reveal again. Humans then have their normal Combat Intrigue window. No units means no bonus.

Yes, Rival gets control bonuses on visits, defensive troop on reveal when it controls space, battle-icon VP and normal worm reward doubling. It always takes optional Conflict VP if it can pay/recall required Spies. It never takes contracts; contract reward gives 2 Solari even with CHOAM.
During Reveal effects, total and announce strength and set marker at any point while resolving, updating as needed. Above 20, flip marker to +20 side and start again at beginning of track.
Leader's Signet Ring ability activates when you play Signet Ring on an Agent turn, not merely Reveal it. Card text can override normal game rules.
A Recall Spy icon on card returns one of your Spies from a post to your supply, usually as a cost. It is not inherently Infiltrate or Gather Intelligence; those are separate no-card recall options.
Trash-an-Intrigue icon trashes one Intrigue you choose from your hand. Ordinary discard instruction means discard a card from your hand and cannot select Intrigue unless specified.

With one worm, doubled reward can be taken twice, and a reward offering one Influence of choice can be doubled to gain 1 with same or two different Factions. A single effect granting two Influence with free choice must put both in one Faction.
answers.evidence: Sandworm Reward Doubling; Special Rules: Influence

answers.answer: Resolve the Rival card's printed Signet Ring ability when revealed Hagal effect has Signet Ring icon; do not substitute Scheme. No human Signet Ring card or Rival Reveal turn is involved.
answers.evidence: Required Rival Rules: Rival Signet Ring and Scheme

answers.answer: Maker Hooks icon: take one from bank only if Rival lacks one. Shield Wall removal: remove only if it has Hooks and wall remains; without Hooks leave wall; if already gone no effect.
answers.evidence: Required Rival Rules: Rival Hooks and Wall icons

answers.answer: Secrets is Bene Gesserit, no cost, not Combat. Gain 1 BG Influence and draw an Intrigue from deck; each opponent with 4+ Intrigues gives one selected at random.
Imperial Basin is Spice Trade, no cost, Combat yes. Visitor gains 1 base spice plus all bonus spice; controller separately gains 1 spice, including when visitor and controller are same player.

At Round Start reveal Conflict from top and place face up next to deck, on top of any unresolved cards from previous rounds; then draw five cards for each player. Thus Conflict reveal precedes hand draws.

Each human places one cube at bottom of each of four Faction tracks. Alliance tokens start on marked spaces of their tracks, not with players. Shield Wall token is placed on board below Spice Refinery at setup.

First Player starts; clockwise one turn at a time. A player who Reveals is skipped for rest of phase; in 3–4-player play phase ends once all have Revealed. Combat Intrigue starts with First Player and proceeds clockwise; each eligible player may play any number or pass, and may act again after pass until all involved pass consecutively.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: Player Turns; Phase 3: Combat

answers.answer: Reveal steps: reveal remaining hand; resolve Reveal boxes (and Persuasion purchases) in any order while setting strength; Clean Up all cards in front into discard pile. Reveal effects need not follow card order.

Shuffle each human's 10-card starting deck face down and place left of Leader; omit CHOAM cards, shuffle Intrigue and Imperium decks separately face down, deal five face-up Imperium Row cards; Reserve piles are Prepare the Way and The Spice Must Flow. Combat marker starts at 0; three Spies in supply; Councilor in supply; Control markers in supply.
Acquire from five Imperium Row cards or Reserve Prepare the Way / The Spice Must Flow; cost shown top right. Normal Persuasion purchasing occurs during Reveal turn.
Yes, ordinary Spy placement and Recall Spy icons are optional even when legal. Shield Wall destruction is optional (“may remove”); once removed it is out for rest of game and cannot return.

Played card needs Agent icon matching destination; connected Spy alone does not confer access to all cards. City-only card cannot send Agent to Shipping via connected Spy. A card bearing Spy Agent icon can send Agent to a space connected to an observation post where you have a Spy; no Spy recall needed.

Yes, a legal Plot Intrigue may be played before Agent placement and any resources it grants then can pay entry. Resources from played Agent card or destination resolve after placement and cannot pay that same entry cost.
No. After both humans Reveal, continue Rival Agent turns while it has Agents in supply; proceed to Combat once both humans Revealed and Rival used all Agents. Rival never Reveals.

| Space | Access icon | Combat? |
|---|---|---|
| Accept Contract | Spice Trade | No |
| Arrakeen | City | Yes |
| Assembly Hall | Landsraad | No |
| Deep Desert | Spice Trade | Yes |
| Deliver Supplies | Spacing Guild | No |
| Desert Tactics | Fremen | Yes |
| Dutiful Service | Emperor | No |
| Espionage | Bene Gesserit | No |
| Fremkit | Fremen | Yes |

| Hagga Basin | Spice Trade | Yes |

| Imperial Basin | Spice Trade | Yes |

| Sietch Tabr | City | Yes |

| Swordmaster | Landsraad | No |

When the Conflict for a location already controlled is revealed at Round Start, controller may deploy one troop from supply directly to Conflict; no Agent visit is needed and bonus is optional. After Combat rewards, all Combat markers reset to 0 before Makers.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: Round Start; Phase 3: Combat

answers.answer: Play a card from your hand face up in front of you and move an Agent from your Leader to the matching unoccupied space; use only its Agent box. You cannot reuse an in-play/discard card or move an Agent already on board instead of taking it from Leader.
Restriction applies immediately when Signet Ring is played to send Agent, for the whole turn; resolving board space first cannot postpone it, so units cannot deploy that turn.
answers.evidence: CHOAM Module: Shaddam’s Signet benefits; Leader clarifications

answers.answer: With four different positive strengths, first, second and third places each get their printed reward; fourth gets none. Highest-strength winner takes Conflict card, then performs battle-icon check.
Players may choose a Leader or select one at random.
Ordinary draw comes from your own deck, not Imperium deck or chosen discard card. If empty, shuffle discard into a new deck and draw.
Shuffle House Hagal deck and place it near shared Rival, retaining the 2P Reshuffle card.
All four Maker Hooks tokens begin in common bank; normal setup gives none to human players. Later acquired token moves from bank to player's garrison.
Yes. Adjust marker when Combat Intrigue resolves during Combat Intrigue window; Reveal value is not fixed. Rewards use adjusted Combat-track strength.
Gained Solari, spice and water come from common bank, not another player's supply.
Shuffle all 20 standard contracts face down, then flip two face up for offers and put rest face down in bank. Players do not choose or preset order.

Before shuffle, set aside both Sardaukar contracts for Shaddam; only Shaddam can acquire them, and he does not start with them. Shuffle the other 18, expose two as public offers, put 16 face down in bank, with two reserved aside.
answers.evidence: CHOAM Module: Setup changes; Reserved Sardaukar contracts
